records.originalRussian: Направьте пристально вашъ взглядъ на черное пятно и смотрите твердо, не мигая, на него въ теченіе одной минуты.
records.normalizedEnglish: Paper black-point gaze with center/right/left placements, rest and timed progression.

setup.circle: Approximately half-rouble coin size, inked on white paper.
setup.position: Seated eye level; chair in middle of room.

rest.details: Repeat central bout after eyes have rested; no numerical rest duration.

records.editorialNote: Reported20/30-minute achievements are not the recommended limit; no guided forced blinking suppression or automatic advancement.

records.originalRussian: Станьте передъ зеркаломъ и пристально смотрите въ отраженіе своихъ глазъ такъ, какъ было указано въ первомъ упражненіи.
records.normalizedEnglish: Stand at a mirror and gaze into reflected eyes as in exercise I, increasing time gradually; combine I and II.

duration.details: No separately stated mirror starting duration.

progression.details: Increase gradually; author recommends systematic practice and combining I/II.

records.originalRussian: самое же упражненіе должно производить вначалѣ очень умѣренно, не утомляя глазъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Stand three feet from wall with eye-level paper/mark; keep mark in view while rotating head in different directions, beginning moderately.

records.originalRussian: Упражненіе это слѣдуетъ немедленно прекратить, какъ только глаза станутъ уставать.
records.normalizedEnglish: Back to wall, gaze rapidly between points on opposite wall; stop at fatigue and finish on one point.
records.termination: Stop immediately when eyes tire; finish with gaze resting on one point.

records.originalRussian: для этого уговорите кого-нибудь изъ вашихъ друзей позволить испробовать на немъ вашъ взглядъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Ask a friend's permission, sit opposite, gaze and ask reciprocal gaze as able; author predicts fatigue/near-hypnosis. Animal tests follow.
prerequisites: Having acquired a firm gaze, develop confidence in it.
records.consentInSource: Friend's permission is explicitly sought; no complete age/withdrawal protocol supplied.
records.withdrawalInSource: Friend saying enough is described as a fatigue/hypnosis marker; no explicit response action prescribed in the paragraph.
records.exclusionReason: No deployed partner-consent flow. Animal/stranger tests, fatigue and hypnosis goals excluded from any future guided adaptation.

records.originalRussian: но вы должны производить опыты надъ лицами, съ которыми встрѣчаетесь, и замѣчать результаты.
records.normalizedEnglish: Author asks readers to experiment on people encountered and notice results; explicit consent/controlled protocol is absent.
records.exclusionReason: No stranger targeting or unconsented influence challenges.

records.originalRussian: Сохраняйте тайну про себя, чтобы ваша сила проявлялась на дѣлѣ, но не на словахъ.
records.normalizedEnglish: Keep training secret; historical advice, not the app's participation or privacy policy.

records.originalRussian: Удѣлите себѣ для упражненій извѣстное время и не торопитесь безъ нужды.
records.normalizedEnglish: Set aside practice time and proceed gradually; no universal daily numeric duration specified.

records.originalRussian: Избѣгайте мигать, щуриться или неестественно расширять вѣки.
records.normalizedEnglish: Author says avoid blinking, squinting or unnaturally widening eyelids; guided mode allows natural blinking.

records.originalRussian: Если ваши глаза отъ упражненій будутъ утомляться, то сполосните ихъ холодной водою, и тотчасъ же появится облегченіе.
records.normalizedEnglish: Author recommends cold-water eye rinsing for fatigue and promises immediate relief; not app medical advice.
